title: The layer ledger: cost read off shapes
caption: The running 784-128-64-10 network with the bill each shape fixes before code runs: 109,386 parameters and 109,184 MACs, of which the input layer alone holds 91.9%. Width enters quadratically because every weight sits in a matrix product; depth adds sequential steps and saved activations.

title: Four kinds of state vs one
caption: The training step holds weights, gradients, optimizer state, and saved activations (~1.3 MB at batch 32); inference keeps the weights plus a rolling pair of activation buffers (~462 KB). The ~3x delta is state that exists only because the backward pass must retrace the forward one.

title: The reject gate turns scores into decisions
caption: The six-stage USPS/check-reader composite: acquisition and preprocessing feed the neural scorer, a confidence threshold splits accepted items from review traffic, and the expected-cost rule prices the split. The 1989 system's 1% error bought its number by rejecting 12.1% of digits.
